cleaning.sequence_duplicates_policy: Retained as distinct original IDs; protein-ID disjointness is not sequence-similarity OOD.

negative_sampling.label_interpretation: Putative negatives: unobserved undirected pairs in the supplied positive network; absence is not experimentally verified non-interaction.
negative_sampling.degree_definition: Undirected endpoint degree in the complete canonical supplied positive network.
negative_sampling.benchmark_design_disclosure: The degree-matched pool is pre-specified using the complete positive network, including held-out positives. This is a benchmark sampling design, not a deployable unknown-edge selection procedure. Full-network degrees must not enter graph construction, learned preprocessing, or model inputs.
negative_sampling.degree_bins: floor(log2(degree + 1)); match sorted endpoint-bin pairs without replacement; nearest available bin pairs fill shortfalls.

protocols.pair: Stratified fixed outer pair folds; every positive and every negative pool pair is tested exactly once. Within each outer training set, 1/8 of each class is held out for validation. With five folds this is approximately 70/10/20. Both negative modes use the same positive memberships and the same negative pool-index memberships. All node identities are available: transductive evaluation.
protocols.protein: Fixed outer node folds, with 1/8 of remaining nodes (at least two) held out for validation. Train/validation/test node IDs are mutually disjoint; only pairs with both endpoints inside a partition are retained. Cross-partition pairs are excluded and counted. Every node is a test node once; some pairs are never tested because their endpoints fall in different outer folds. Negative pools and node assignments are fixed before evaluation. This is ID-disjoint both-protein holdout, not sequence-homology OOD.

graph_policy: Each graph.npz contains exactly the corresponding training positives as canonical E x 2 undirected edges. Message-passing code may expand these edges in both directions; validation/test edges and full-positive degrees must never be added.
identity_scope: Original numeric CSV protein IDs are preserved verbatim as integers. This preparation does not assert or certify species, disease association, interaction evidence type, or STRING confidence threshold.
